items.title: US floated idea of Ukraine swapping land for NATO membership, Zelensky says
items.brief: The United States floated the idea of Ukraine ceding the eastern Donbas region to Russia in exchange for NATO membership during recent talks , Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

items.title: Deputy working security at South Carolina gun show fatally shoots customer who shot him
items.brief: Columbia, South Carolina (AP) — A deputy working security at a gun show in South Carolina fatally shot someone who fired on him Saturday, authorities said.

items.title: What we know about the cause of the nationwide FAA ground stop
items.brief: All flights nationwide were grounded for hours on Friday after a systems failure, leading to thousands of flights being delayed or canceled, disrupting the travel plans of passengers heading into the weekend.

items.title: ‘No answer’: Messaging failures worsened the air traffic freeze and sowed distrust in government
items.brief: Communications failures in the air on Friday were followed by communications failures on the ground.

items.title: Tanker ‘lost control’ and hit cruise ship in New Orleans, spurring massive evacuation, officials say
items.brief: Passengers of a river cruise boat in New Orleans had to be pulled from the Mississippi river on Friday after a tanker collided with the paddlewheeler as it sat in dock, causing it to capsize.
